question: Who has won the World Sportsman of the Year award at the 2025 Laureus World Sports Awards?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mondo Duplantis.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Swedish pole vaulter Mondo Duplantis won the 2025 Laureus World Sportsman of the Year award.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Duplantis made history by becoming the first back-to-back Olympic men’s pole vault champion in over 50 years.
 
• He broke the world pole vault record for the ninth time, showcasing extraordinary consistency and excellence.
 
• The award was presented by last year’s winner, tennis star Novak Djokovic.
 
• Duplantis described the recognition as a "once-in-a-lifetime" honour, reflecting his global impact in athletics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• *Full list of winners at the 2025 Laureus World Sports Awards:*

 
 
• World Sportsman of the Year: Mondo Duplantis
 
• World Sportswoman of the Year: Simone Biles
 
• World Team of the Year: Real Madrid
 
• World Breakthrough of the Year: Lamine Yamal
 
• World Comeback of the Year: Rebeca Andrade
 
• Sportsperson of the Year with a Disability: Jiang Yuyan
 
• World Action Sportsperson of the Year: Tom Pidcock
 
• Sport for Good Award: Kick4Life
 
• Sporting Icon Award: Rafael Nadal
 
• Lifetime Achievement Award: Kelly Slate
